_comment: The shared reference library. Lessons do not carry their own hints; each lesson names the ids it unlocks. Order here is the order entries appear within a group in the panel.

entries.title: Assigning a variable
entries.markdown: Name on the left, value on the right.

entries.title: Showing a value in the console
entries.markdown: `print()` writes a value to the output area.

entries.title: Averaging an array
entries.markdown: Functions from numpy are written with the `np.` prefix.

entries.title: Quotes
entries.markdown: `signal` is a variable. `"signal"` is the word as plain text. They are not the same thing.

entries.title: Adding variables
entries.markdown: Python supports standard mathematical operations such as addition, subtraction and multiplication with variables. The result can be stored in a new variable.
